description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:1338-1404: The NoCheckShim approach is the right pattern. RFC 6960 §4.2.2.2.1 nocheck bypass is a per-cert, per-call concern that the RevocationChecker trait shouldn't know about (otherwise every implementer would have to carry the responsibility). Wrapping the caller's checker in a shim that short-circuits for one identified cert is clean. The LeafIdent(issuer DN, serial) identifier follows RFC 5280 §4.1.2.2's uniqueness contract directly. A future contributor might suggest adding a 'bypass set' parameter to RevocationChecker::check_revocation — defend the shim: the bypass is a wrapper-layer concern (only verify_ocsp_responder knows when it applies), pushing it into the trait would make every other RevocationChecker carry useless ceremony.
title: NoCheckShim for OCSP responder id-pkix-ocsp-nocheck — preserve
